add.k: An Air Force major loyal to the Rambeaus
st: Major Goodner builds an armored space rover for Monica, then watches the Hex flip it and hurl it back out to explode.

files.notes: Named in dialogue in WV E7 ('Major Goodner.' / 'Captain Rambeau.'); first name Aly is never said, so n is 'Major Goodner'. Group: 'U.S. Air Force' came only from her uniform tapes, which the owner's rule treats as a marking on clothes, not a group; the story places her with S.W.O.R.D. (she brings the S.W.O.R.D. space rover to the S.W.O.R.D. base at the Hex and says Maria is not the only one they are loyal to), so the app's 'S.W.O.R.D.' is used.

add.k: Westview's doctor, trapped in Wanda's sitcom
st: Dr. Nielson tells Wanda she is four months pregnant, then is pulled from his broken car by Vision and delivers her second twin, Billy.

files.notes: WV E3: Wanda says 'Dr. Nielson' and his wife calls him 'Stan'. Only on screen in E3. 'Stan Nielson' is the sitcom role; his real name is never given. No group named, so Independent.

add.k: Elsa's late father, keeper of the Bloodstone
st: Ulysses Bloodstone's rigged corpse opens his funeral hunt, promising his Bloodstone to whoever slays a captured monster.

files.notes: Name said by the narrator and by Verussa and Jovan. On screen only as a corpse worked by machinery that speaks his recorded wishes. Filed T because his will makes Ted the prey and he led the hunters' 'crusade against monsters'; A as Elsa's father is defensible. Group uses the app's 'Bloodstone's hunters' (on screen they are only 'hunters', 'our cause').

k: A Damage Control boss worried about prison costs
st: Heyerdahl vows DeMarr Davis will be watched for life, demands more prisoners for Damage Control, and finds Trevor's cell empty.

files.notes: Name never said; SHOWN in E4 on a Hot Goss news caption 'DODC DEPUTY SECRETARY HEYERDAHL' (checked the wiki screenshot). Cleary calls him 'Deputy Secretary' in E5 and E8. First on screen in E3 (prison quota meeting), so n and k are staged to E4. In story order the E4 press conference comes first.

st: Frank, of the Hanover Agency, urges DeMarr to try acting and later tells him his Expellax commercial deal is being cut short.
Frank sits in on a Hanover Agency meeting when Simon bursts in hunting for Janelle.

files.notes: Says 'Frank Preminger, Hanover Agency' in E4; DeMarr calls him Frank. The E4 Doorman story happens years earlier, so it comes first in his own order. The E1 step rests on the wiki's E1 cast list and gallery ('Hanover Agency Meeting', 'Simon interrupts meeting'); his part there is tiny and could be cut.

add.k: Maker of chamoy candy, Jayden's old partner
st: Esteban feeds Trevor peach rings, explains his Chamoy Dudes split with Jayden, and forgives him as a dealer holds Jayden at gunpoint.

files.notes: Named in dialogue in E5. 'Chamoy Dudes' is said on screen as the candy operation he and Jayden started; it is his own group and is not yet in groups_in_app. The wiki lists him in E8 (Yucca Valley) too, but the transcript does not show what he does there, so no step was added for it.

add.k: A street cameraman who blackmails Simon
st: Jayden films Simon's powers and blackmails him, then, held at gunpoint by a dealer, gives up the footage and begs Esteban's pardon.

files.notes: Named in dialogue in E5. He left the Chamoy Dudes before the story starts ('He started his own operation', never named), so Independent. Filed T because he spends his time blackmailing Simon; he reconciles with Esteban at the end. The wiki lists him in E8 too, but nothing he does there could be confirmed.

st: Sanford takes young Simon to see the 1980 Wonder Man instead of school, tells him he has a gift, and dies some years later.

files.notes: Martha says 'Sanford' in E3 (and that Simon's bike fall came 'a few years after Sanford passed'). Surname never said with it, so n is 'Sanford'. On screen in flashbacks in E1, E7 and E8, and as a photo in E3; ep set to E8, the last scene shown.

st: Vivian moves out on Simon, then, after booking a part on Severance, tells him she always knew his secret and kept it.

files.notes: Simon says 'Vivian' in E1; Kathy Friedman names her again in E7. Also seen in old self-tape footage in E2. A small part on Severance is a one-job hire, so Independent.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Monica asks Major Goodner, loyal to her mother, for an armored rover that can cross into the Hex. Goodner delivers it, but the barrier flips it and throws it back, so Monica walks in on foot.
stages.whoA: The captain she builds a rover for
stages.whoB: An Air Force major who builds her rover

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Monica introduces Agent Woo to Major Goodner when the rover arrives. The two watch together as the Hex rejects the rover and it explodes.
stages.whoA: An FBI agent who watches the launch with her
stages.whoB: The major who built Monica's rover

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Dr. Nielson tells Wanda she looks four months pregnant, though she has been pregnant less than a day. Hours later he arrives in time to deliver her second son, Billy, and calls both boys healthy.
stages.whoA: His patient, who gives birth within a day
stages.whoB: Westview's doctor, who delivers her twins

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Vision walks Dr. Nielson out after the checkup, then rushes him from his broken car to deliver the baby. Seeing him home, Nielson says small towns are so hard to escape.
stages.whoA: The nervous father who fetches him
stages.whoB: The town doctor he rushes to Wanda

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Elsa comes home after 20 years for the funeral of her father, Ulysses, whose wishes make his Bloodstone the prize of a hunt. Verussa says Elsa forsook her birthright, but Elsa ends the night holding the stone.
stages.whoB: Her late father, a famed hunter

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Verussa stages her late husband's funeral hunt, with his corpse rigged to speak his wishes. Ulysses thanks her for seeing it through, and she calls him a leader and a lover without equal.
stages.whoA: His widow, who runs his hunt

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Hunters gather from around the globe for Ulysses' funeral. His corpse tells them the hunter who slays the monster becomes their new leader and keeper of the Bloodstone.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: By Ulysses' wishes, his Bloodstone is fixed to a captured monster to weaken and anger it, making it the prey of his funeral hunt. Jack later names the monster as his friend Ted.
stages.whoA: The monster his will makes prey
stages.whoB: The dead hunter whose will makes him prey

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Heyerdahl warns his agents that the half-empty prison must be filled, then tells a late-working Cleary he would love to keep him around. At the prison, Cleary briefs him on Simon's ionic powers just before the alarm sends them to Trevor's empty cell.
stages.whoA: An agent he pushes to fill the prison
stages.whoB: His boss, Damage Control's deputy secretary

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Frank of the Hanover Agency meets DeMarr on a film set and tells him to think about acting, and DeMarr becomes a star. Later, at a bar, Frank tells him his commercial deal is being cut short and to be careful with money.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Esteban and Jayden started the Chamoy Dudes together before greed split them, and Jayden sends Simon to take a motorcycle from Esteban. Held at gunpoint outside Esteban's door, Jayden apologizes, and Esteban forgives him.
stages.whoB: His old partner, who forgives him

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Esteban, who did Mandarin impressions in middle school, welcomes Trevor in and wins him over with chamoy peach rings. When a dealer comes for Trevor, Esteban tells him he has to go.
stages.whoA: The Mandarin, a fan of his peach rings
stages.whoB: A Mandarin fan who makes chamoy candy

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Simon arrives posing as an undercover cop to take back Jayden's motorcycle, but Esteban explains Jayden lied about it. Simon and Trevor end up on Esteban's side.
stages.whoA: A fake cop sent to scare him
stages.whoB: The candy maker he was sent to scare

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Jayden films Simon using his powers on Trevor's dealer and threatens to post the video unless Simon scares Esteban. Once the lie comes out, Simon only wants the GoPro back.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Trevor distrusts Jayden from the start. When a dealer holds Jayden hostage to draw Trevor out, Trevor says he is no friend, then cheers when Jayden gives up the footage.
stages.whoA: The actor who won't save him

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Sanford takes young Simon to see Wonder Man instead of school, telling him being different can be great. Over burgers he says Simon has a gift, and years after his death Simon becomes Wonder Man.
stages.whoA: His son, who dreams of acting
stages.whoB: His late father, who saw his gift

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Sanford drives his sons to school, with teenage Eric heading off to football practice. At Simon's Wonder Man premiere, Eric wishes their dad could have been there.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Vivian moves out on Simon, saying he never let her in. Meeting again over Kathy Friedman's profile, she tells him she always knew he was different and kept his secret.

Name never said or shown in Werewolf by Night; the wiki sources it to the credits. She is covered by The Monster Hunters group file.
Name never said in Werewolf by Night: 'Joshua' is only a closed-caption speaker label and 'Jovan' is only in the credits. He is covered by The Monster Hunters group file.
Name never said or shown in Wonder Man E5: he only calls Trevor 'Trev', and no one names him.

changes.why: 'U.S. Air Force' rested only on the tapes on her uniform; under the owner's rule (8 November 2026) a marking on clothes is not a group. In the story she works with S.W.O.R.D. at its base outside the Hex and builds the S.W.O.R.D. space rover for Monica, so the app's 'S.W.O.R.D.' is her group.

changes.was: ...Used the app's 'U.S. Air Force'; switch to Independent if uniform tapes are judged a logo under the Dennis rule.
changes.why: Notes updated to match the group change.

changes.was: Dr. Nielson tells Wanda she is four months pregnant, then is pulled from his broken car by Vision to deliver her twin boys.
changes.now: Dr. Nielson tells Wanda she is four months pregnant, then is pulled from his broken car by Vision and delivers her second twin, Billy.
changes.why: He does not deliver both twins: Wanda gives birth to Tommy with Geraldine's help before he arrives ('Oh, no. I missed it.'), and he delivers only the second baby, Billy ('There's another baby coming.' / 'Billy?').
